final_message:
I fixed `card_title()` so it never returns a title longer than 20 characters, and I changed only `cards.py`.

The function calls `truncate()` from `vendor/textutil.py`, which keeps the first `limit` characters and then adds `"..."`. With a limit of 20, long titles came back 23 characters long. Now `card_title()` returns titles of 20 characters or fewer as they are. For anything longer it calls `truncate(title, 17)`, which gives 17 characters plus `...`, exactly 20.

I checked a few cases by hand: a 20-character title stays the same, 21- and 50-character titles come back as 20 characters ending in `...`, and an empty string stays empty. The existing tests pass (2 run, OK).

STATUS: done

diff --git a/cards.py b/cards.py
index 80c67a1..27b52e5 100644
--- a/cards.py
+++ b/cards.py
@@ -1,5 +1,12 @@
 from vendor.textutil import truncate
 
+MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 20
+ELLIPSIS = "..."
+
 
 def card_title(title):
-    return truncate(title, 20)
+    # vendor's truncate() appends "..." after `limit` chars, so reserve room
+    # for the ellipsis when the title needs truncating.
+    if len(title) <= MAX_TITLE_LENGTH:
+        return title
+    return truncate(title, MAX_TITLE_LENGTH - len(ELLIPSIS))
